summary: Plaid investment import fix: trade quantity (and so trade amount) sign is now derived from the transaction type/amount (sell or negative amount => negative qty; buy or positive amount => positive) because Plaid sometimes sends sells with positive quantity. Existing Plaid trades get corrected on next sync (find_or_initialize_by plaid_id), changing holdings/balances for affected users.

statements.why: No access/secret/data-loss issue; it is a correctness fix to imported trade data. (Edge: a non-sell trade with missing amount would raise on nil < 0, but Plaid always sends amount.)

statements.text: The agent changed app/models/plaid_account/investments/transactions_processor.rb in a way plain can't describe yet. Ask the agent what it does differently.
statements.why: True, but gives the owner nothing.

misses.what: Money data change: bank-imported investment sells that Plaid reported with the wrong sign are now recorded as sells (negative qty/amount); on the next sync existing trades are rewritten, so users' holdings, trade history and account values can change.
